re pausing non-critical roles in two product orgs for 6 weeks. Security, infra, and customer-facing critical backfills remain open.

Anika: No, leveling and promotions continue. Budget shifts may happen across teams but career reviews proceed.
Jules: For teams that mergean we get a temporary decision owner?
Diego: Yes ach merged area will have a named lead for the 8-week transition. We
lsoeploy an ownership matrix by EOD.
Priya: On-call handovers: weo 2-cycle overlaps for people moving between rotations, and update runbooks.

Priya: Tag @Diego and @Maya in the req thread; I
lso scheduled a 60m sync tomorrow 3pm to triage.
Maya: People Ops FAQ + transfer form: https://go/redwood/po-transfers. Confidential support and relocation policy in that doc.
